description: The line plot titled “Whisper fine-tuning, type = small” illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance over six training epochs for four different fine-tuning configurations of the Whisper small model. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 25.0 to 42.5, with major gridlines and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. Four distinct lines are plotted: “small AdaLoRA_int4” (solid orange line with circle markers) starts at WER ≈35.5, peaks at epoch 2 (≈36.0), then declines steadily to ≈31.0 at epoch 6; “small AdaLoRA_int8” (dashed orange line with square markers) begins at ≈30.0, rises sharply to a peak of ≈42.5 at epoch 2, then drops to ≈25.5 by epoch 6; “small int4” (solid orange line with circle markers, slightly darker) starts at ≈30.0, dips to ≈28.5 at epoch 2, then gradually decreases to ≈25.0 at epoch 6; and “small int8” (dashed orange line with square markers, slightly darker) begins at ≈30.0, rises to ≈33.5 at epoch 1, then falls to ≈25.5 at epoch 6. All lines show non-monotonic behavior, with some peaking early and others improving steadily, reflecting varying convergence patterns across quantization and adaptation methods.
